rules.desc: the first line must be `// name: quake-app`
bind every displayed value via sys.quakes (masthead count + LATEST block + 6 feed rows)
the four sys.maptile quadrants of the single zoomable mosaic
the mosaic centering margin via sys.mappin x + y offsets against the 744 mosaic
the mosaic margin subtracts the mappin offsets from the pane half-size
full-size 372x372 tiles (and 744-wide rows) for the true-centered mosaic
the three stepper buttons all target the zoom key
the − button steps down within bounds
the + button steps up within bounds
inc/dec clamp to the supported ladder
every pane sys call + indicator uses the defaulted zoom slot
the required OSM/CARTO tile attribution below the map pane
